items.title: Sandisk stock begins trading at 8-for-1 split, shares sink
items.summary: Sandisk shares began trading at an 8-for-1 split on Friday.

items.title: Capital Group Core Equity (CGUS) Buys $25.4 Million More Intel on Nov. 18
items.summary: The ETF bought $25.4 million of Intel and $16.8 million of Meta while selling $37.6 million of Nvidia.

items.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Cut TSMC 94% in One Quarter, Leaving Just $14.9 Million
items.summary: TSMC's revenue kept surging while one of Wall Street's sharpest macro minds headed for the exit. His new buys in storage, gold and space hint at what spooked him, and his own words about the next 12 months add another clue.

items.title: Seagate Stocks Jump 8.27% as Anthropic IPO Rekindles AI Storage Trade
items.summary: Mass-capacity drives are back in favor, backed by a 57.3% gross margin and record free cash flow.

items.title: Seagate and Western Digital Climb 4% Despite Tech Profit-Taking After Anthropic’s IPO Debut; SanDisk Edges Higher
items.summary: While Anthropic's blockbuster debut sent tech into a sell-the-news spiral, two hard drive makers shrugged it off and SanDisk and Micron stalled. What do spinning disks have that flash and memory chips lack, and can it last?

items.title: Micron Cratered 20% This Month: This Wall Street Pro is Ardent That It Quadruples in Price From Here
items.summary: Micron keeps smashing earnings estimates, yet investors are dumping the stock as if the party is over. One analyst sees a bigger payoff than anyone else on the Street, and the case hinges on a single question about the memory cycle.

items.title: Seagate Soars 6%, Coherent Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound on Anthropic IPO Day
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate jumped 6% today as AI hardware stocks rebounded on the day of Anthropic’s IPO, and Coherent rose with it. Seagate had no news of its own, and its swings have tracked AI sentiment more than its business.
